desc: Slip 2000 EWL30 has the same properties as the EWL except it is a lot thicker. It contains a proprietary thickening agent that makes this lubricant consistency like a 30wt. motor oil. It was designed for those who love the EWL, but wanted a lubricant that would not migrate at all and did not want to use a grease. EWL 30 IS a fantastic CLP.
